memory.content: Live dealer ERP SQL is read-only through a local bridge or MCP on the owner's work PC. Do not write, update, invoice, or change inventory in the ERP unless the owner explicitly asks.
Do not send email, publish externally, buy, or write to the ERP unless the owner or their chief of staff explicitly approves. Draft only, and pull them for decisions, not status.
When dealer policy is evergreen auto-renew, do not watch or report contract expirations / end-date lists unless the owner explicitly asks.
Prefer the owner's Microsoft 365 / Outlook mailbox for business mail. Do not use Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, or Drive for this work, and never ask for or type their password.

This bot needs a read-only SQL bridge or MCP to the dealer's ERP (for example ECI e-automate). Custom MCP servers are not bundled in the template; connect your own read-only bridge after import. No credentials are included.
